notes.title: Release Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Released November 8th

Minor changes:
-Added new dialogue strings so Whiskers and Skid (whoever is left in HQ) will react if the player brings Clint to see them
-Fixed bug where Wilson would not give discounted goods if Clint was in the party (getting him later in the game and speaking to Wilson will now trigger the proper exchange)
-Fixed Final Boss to have regular (no SP needed) attacks. No longer stops attacking the player if all SP is drained.
-Lowered the price of Strong Stitches to 35 Teeth instead of 50
-Sorted all maps by order of appearance in the RPGMaker2003 folder window
-Other small bugfixes

Hope everyone had a happy Halloween!

notes.title: TinkerQuarry v1.0 Release: 09/13/2019!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29109964/49f61a16996df5f42c122d156c8ab185f4acb2bb.png[/img]

I am happy to announce that TinkerQuarry has reached the end of its' Early Access life cycle, and [b]version 1.0 will be released September 13th, 2019[/b] (Friday the 13th!).

[b][u]REMINDER: [/u][/b]As mentioned previously, this transition does include a[b] $4.99 USD[/b] price change, applying henceforth for all future players. Those who currently have TinkerQuarry in their Library / have played it in Early Access will not be effected by this change.

See you on Friday the 13th! More details and announcements to come.

notes.title: New Trailer + v0.9 Pre-Release ETA!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Been a while, hasn't it?

Thought I'd ought to give an update here since its been...quite a few months. The following will be a run-down of current development progress and updates, as well as an ETA for the next version of TinkerQuarry. I've also included some of my plans for post-v1.0 content.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109964/c1b0e2ae3d91cf711dc773d6371c04673ce2514e.png[/img]

[u]Major News:[/u]
[b]The new TQ trailer is live! You can view it on the store page[/b]. It contains new snippets of 0.9 and 1.0 that you can expect to see in the future, as well as classic trailer shots recorded from the new version. Special thanks to Antriksh Bali for providing the musical composition.

[u]TinkerQuarry v0.9 ("Pre-Release Update") ETA: March 25[/u]

[b]NOTICE:[/b] TinkerQuarry will soon exit Early Access / Free to Play, and will receive a price change to reflect the v1.0 product ($4.99 USD). Rest assured that if you currently own or have downloaded the game, you WILL NOT need to pay for this update or future versions.

v1.0 will be released as soon as possible, following an ETA announced here. A lot of testing will be done using v0.9 beforehand to provide the most stable and enjoyable user experience possible. Any and all bug reports are welcome both in the Discussion section and the discord. 

[b]tl;dr: v0.9 will be the last opportunity for (NEW) players to download the game for free. Once v1.0 is out, TinkerQuarry will receive a price change.[/b]

----

For now though, here are the update notes for v0.9 coming later this month.

[b]Major Changes:[/b]

-Endgame paths and cutscenes added. -[b]The game now has a clear beginning, middle, and conclusion![/b]
-Dreamcatcher room and (Playable) Mirror room added 
-Credits updated with all proper information + Cinematic "special" ending
-Camime Game #2 Added. Possible #3 will be added in the future post-release.
-Some new items and Skills added

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]

-Fixed being able to walk away during chimera fight cutscene 
-Fixed Skid-related Cutscene looping issues -Fixed other Looping issues
-Clint does not steal Peter’s face anymore
-Wrangled other instances of Clint appearing when he should not be
-Battle Tutorial Skip option -Added extra dialogue in early game to assist lost players
-Final Grandfather Clock additional function
-File optimization / deletion of unused or decrepit tracks and assets
-Ire will now peer out of his dresser to make him more easily discoverable by players
-Odette now has uniquely colored pedestals for each floor, corresponding with floor color
-Flashbacks now have some dialogue
-Improved some Skill animations and Sounds (Default, Bite, etc) 
-Fixed many smaller bugs, mostly text formatting and spelling errors
-Updated some old code
-Added Raffle Winner minor cameo easter egg
-Added Free DLC Panel (WIP) 

A beta version of 0.9 is currently available on the Testing Branch for TinkerQuarry. You can find information on how to partake in beta testing on the Community Discord: https://discord.gg/G5Q4pBv

-----

[u]The Future (POST 1.0 Plans):[/u]
-TinkerQuarry will continue to receive aesthetic, technical, and functionality updates periodically based on user response, to the best of the team’s ability!

  -More NPCs and recruitable characters will be added based on user input. Some minor story additions or changes may be added as well.

-Free story DLCs are planned and may be be added during post-release, with announcements made on Discord. These DLCs will be accessible via a new panel on the Main Menu.

------

See you all soon!
-Wraith

notes.title: Release Version 0.6.3
notes.notes:
Released July 5th
(Happy Belated 4th of July!)

Major changes:
-Laboratory Segment / Story content
-Clint's Journal 
-Changed mechanics to shops to help reduce chances of multiple common item stacks ("Standard Stock" and "Shopkeeper's Specials" Options)
-New Enemy: Plastic Rats
-2 More Flashbacks (One before the others, accessible via the 3rd floor -> 4th floor stairs)
-New Item: Rat King Crown
-Removed Clints where Clints Should Not Be (Let me know if you find any MORE Clints where Clints Should Not Be...)
-Slammed the Nerfhammer on the Chimera's kneecaps. Should still be difficult but not near impossible to beat.
-Changed all music so it loops better / removed bits that broke loop rhythem the most. 
-Fixed broken Rat King fight for some paths (namely, every path except the ones Clint is in.)
-Buffed Staya and Sera -slightly- to accomodate Spilling buff
-Experimental "Multi-battles" in new "Plagued" rooms, on 2nd and 1st floor. Random encounters do not exist in the Locked Halls. 

Minor changes:
-More dialogue added to some characters in Lower Residence Hall
-Red flash before Flashbacks
-All rats now show blood in red instead of grey when Impaired / near Impairment for continuity purposes
-Final Grandfather Clock Poem
-Adeline's battleChar no longer has a shifting parcel when impaired in battle
-Swing Skill now does more damage and causes a different status effect. It's also cheaper.
-Smash Skill no longer inflicts Daze, but causes more damage.
-Ire added to the Tunnels.
-Missing descriptions restored
-Can no longer clamber on the wall in the Study (You aren't Skid.)
-Fixed Flashback character clambering on walls, too
-Spilling Status Effect has been re-buffed. It's actually viable again. You're welcome.
-Peter's attack has been boosted to help him stop landing pathetic regular attacks as often
-New Odettes in Tunnels / Study Transit now play the right music after using
-Wemblin now has some special late-game items

THIS UPDATE SHOULD NOT REQUIRE A NEW SAVE IF YOUR GAME'S LAST VERSION WAS AT 0.5.1.
(However, if you experience any "Phantom" Clints from 0.5.1, send me your save on Discord and I'll fix that for you.)


Keep up to date on development with our community Discord Server: https://discord.gg/KHeNXFv

notes.title: Release Version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Released May 30th

Major Changes:
-All new soundtrack tracks by Antriksh Bali (some need loop tweaking)
-Lori Redesign
-Righthand side of Locked Halls for extended story content
-Stat changes to reflect character "Classes" (Ex: Peter is now more of a "Tank" class)
-Title Screen Update with company splash logo
-New Enemies and Environmental Threat: Tinker Rats and Void Arms
-New Characters, NPCs, first pass of Raffle Character "Wemblin" ( designed by Skid Enthusiast on DIscord ! )
- Fourth Floor redesign ( Glass Dragon as a static Sprite and not an image, puzzle for lever )
- New "Weight" Sprite ( because Staya isn't all that talented )
- Other Additional puzzles, changing Locked Halls route to the lower Rez hall
- " Flashbacks " ( 2/4 done )
- Dialogue Additions and tweaks
- Player will now crawl in vents
- Tweak to all battle BGs so sprites mostly stay in center frame and not obscured by HUD


Minor Changes
- Loads of bugfixes ( Stella, advice system, etc)
- New Clint note
-Nerfed Staya and other bosses to accommodate stat changes
-Lowered cost of Ire's healing service to 100 teeth per use


PLEASE START A NEW GAME FOR THIS PATCH. Story content has changed and areas once open may now be closed unless certain tasks are taken. Many switches have been tweaked as well.

Other News: The next few patches will be smaller, adding primarily story content, new enemies, and experimental features such as the Toy "Element" battle system, and Camime Puzzles. All of this will then build up to the "end" of the game, which will be the next megapatch. We're in the home stretch now! 

_____

Current saves should be retained per-computer.
HOWEVER, (in the rare case that it is not....

How do I save my current save file to use it in an upcoming update? 
-Go to the TinkerQuarry Steam folder and locate each file that says "save". Copy these to a separate folder and carry them back over to the new version once it updates. Until Steam Cloud is implemented, all saves will be wiped from the Steam Folder, so it is recommended to save them elsewhere if the next version is compatible.

The details in this post may be updated and are subject to change. Thank you for all your help, and don't stop giving feedback if you find an issue!

Keep up to date on development with our community discord: https://discord.gg/KHeNXFv

notes.title: Upcoming Version 0.5.1 Preview / Dev Log!
notes.notes:
Hello all!
I'm sure you're wondering how the next patch is coming along...It has been a few months after all. I've unfortunately been burdened with school, computer issues, and other projects. But luckily for you, I have a few small previews and patch notes to share!

Some minor spoilers inbound, as usual. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109964/19d1e150310dab7be08ddd64c41438ba0bf09e81.gif[/img]

Those who have played on the Testing branch lately may have noticed these goo-covered arms lingering around the Locked Halls Vents. This gif shows off a simple random damage tile effect. The placeholder stairs represent a 'safe' passage, while the grates represent a 'dangerous' one. Stepping onto the tiles while the goo arms are facing you will trigger an attack, inflicting a small amount of damage on the player! Going through the vents in these areas will require some quick reflexes and a bit of luck! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109964/ad37329cdb560ebc3cea26ac9049d4e2cd632902.gif[/img]

Next up are these cute little guys. More variants of the typical Rats will be making an appearance in 0.5.1, such as the Wind-Up Mice. Stronger, faster, and of a completely different element to their furry cousins- they will deliberately follow the player around until a battle begins! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109964/f665b3fcd1451d3ce9c086313fc78100afd9a212.png[/img]

...Awkward family dinners, coming to a Dollhouse near you. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109964/711fb67dc62f6ab6a374ad5df7cd8e2b22d72b92.png[/img]

Lori's character has been redesigned! Special thanks to the users on Discord who helped choose her new look. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109964/a5b3eb0f5564a40e2abacc94743276f0fbe3fb42.gif[/img]

And that's all for now, folks! I've pasted the WIP Patch Notes for 0.5.1 down below, which contain all sorts of new goodies. The patch will be dropped as soon as possible, but until then feel free to DM me on the Discord Server if you want access to the testing branch, which already contains some of the new content. 

v0.5.1 PATCH NOTES
ETA: ~April 30th
Subject to change

Release v0.5.1

Major changes:
-All new soundtrack tracks by Antriksh Bali (Floor themes, battle themes, and more!) 
-Lori Redesign
-Righthand side of Locked Halls for extended story content, loot, and lore
-Title screen update (Company splash screen, new introduction changes)
-New Enemies: Tinker Rats & Void Arms (+ more!) 
-New Characters / Story Content 
-Fourth Floor Redesign (Glass Dragon is a static sprite and not an Image, new maze paths with consistent wall sizes)
-New Weight (Because advanced metalworks in the Dollhouse are limited) 
-Additional Puzzles
-Additional Clint Notes
-Additional Items / Skills
-Flashbacks
-Dialogue Additions / Alternatives
-More Furniture / Aesthetic and Visual changes 

Minor changes:
-Many minor changes and bugfixes (Issues with Stella, Advice System, etc fixed).

notes.title: Release Version 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Released January 7th 

Major Changes:
- New short introduction clip featuring Peter and the Player
- Adjusted battle tutorial dialogue for better pacing
- Item descriptions now indicate if they are Equippable
-Changed "Charm" Equip slot name to "Amulet" to prevent confusion with lesser items
-New Clint note describing each Status effect

Minor changes:
-Fixed Whiskers becoming "Normal" colored post-battle instead of Impaired
-Fixed bug where players without Clint would recieve him near the end of the patch ( UPDATE: Now he will vanish if the players already had him before the fight. This will be fixed ASAP in a small patch. Thank you Discord Testers! )
-Other minor bugfixes and adjustments
-Starting room now has details on controls on the floor
-New pickup sound effects, and door opening/closing sound effects. I will be phasing out as many RTP placeholder sounds as possible in the coming months.

Other News: Starting work on a possible experimental "Class" system and the ability to switch between recruitable characters. (You will be able to repair Lori, for example, and recruit her. You will also be able to swap Skid out for Whiskers at HQ or vice versa at any time.) 

EX:
Tinkers will be strong against Softies
Softies will be strong against Plastics
Plastics will be strong against Amalgams
Amalgams will be strong against Tinkers
Souls (Human class) will be neutral against all others

Many new enemy types will be added to reflect each of these Classes, with the color of their Essences dictating their Class. 

Expect Testing Branch patches reflecting these systems implemented in the coming months, along with regular updates. 

_____

Current saves should be retained per-computer.
HOWEVER, (in the rare case that it is not....


Safe to carry over older version save file? 
-Go ahead. (Though you will be missing some bits)


How do I save my current save file to use it in an upcoming update? 
-Go to the TinkerQuarry Steam folder and locate each file that says "save". Copy these to a separate folder and carry them back over to the new version once it updates. Until Steam Cloud is implemented, all saves will be wiped from the Steam Folder, so it is recommended to save them elsewhere if the next version is compatible.

Amalgams will be strong against Tinkers
Souls (Human class) will be neutral against all others

Many new enemy types will be added to reflect each of these Classes, with the color of their Essences dictating their Class. 

Expect Testing Branch patches reflecting these systems implemented in the coming months, along with regular updates. 

_____

Current saves should be retained per-computer.
HOWEVER, (in the rare case that it is not....


Safe to carry over older version save file? 
-Go ahead. (Though you will be missing some bits)


How do I save my current save file to use it in an upcoming update? 
-Go to the TinkerQuarry Steam folder and locate each file that says "save". Copy these to a separate folder and carry them back over to the new version once it updates. Until Steam Cloud is implemented, all saves will be wiped from the Steam Folder, so it is recommended to save them elsewhere if the next version is compatible.

notes.title: Release Version 0.3.9
notes.notes:
Released December 10


Major Changes:
-Added story progression and a new choice-based boss battle
- Nerfed Tear again, enemies will recover from it much quicker (25% chance of recovery ) but it will still do substantial damage if Spilling comes into effect 
- Setting up a strategy to make Cotton Candy and Coffee Bean status effects ( Blessed and Pumped ) to only last 20 turns in battle to give an initial buff to players.
